drafts_today.text: Shopping for the woman who says she needs nothing? Give her skin a calm winter: a gentle cleanser, a hydrating serum, a rich cream. Three steps, no stinging actives, wrapped in one box. 🎁 #giftideas #SkinBarrier
Menopause skin and holiday gifts have one thing in common: gentle wins. Skip the 10-piece kit with strong acids. Pick fewer products that soothe a dry, reactive barrier. #MenopauseSkin #holidayseason

Sechelt mornings are getting cold, and so is the air indoors with the heat on. If your face feels tight by noon, that's winter dryness. Moisturize on damp skin and keep one cream by the sink. #WinterSkin #SkinCare
